name: assets-reload
description: Hot reload: the window watches the joint limits, the library and the samples and runs assets.reload for what changed. Reloading the limits reads one range per rig bone (104). A part set saved, reloading the library counts it (1) and the poses; reloading the samples reads the 6 shipped samples (assets/samples/*.clip.json) and their 6 recipes (assets/samples/recipes/*.json, one named after each). Everything (the default) reloads in the order limits, library, samples. Something it can't reload is refused.
